rationale: The Latin anchor *auxilium* ("help, assistance") points to an active sense of contributing aid or support, which aligns with aid.n.02 (the activity of contributing to a need or effort) rather than aid.n.01 (a static resource). The medical attestations (Lchdm., Herb.) further suggest BÓT in the sense of actively rendering remedy/assistance, consistent with the activity-oriented synset.
